summary: Ruanyun Edai Technology Inc. filed a Form 6-K on August 3, 2026, announcing its fiscal 2026 financial results via press release. The company reported 11.9% revenue growth to $7.48 million, with campus operations contributing $5.72 million, and a return to positive equity of $5.28 million. Net loss widened to $7.91 million from $0.52 million. The release also mentions a proposed name change to Formind Group. This is a routine earnings announcement for a foreign private issuer, not a special situation. The filing contains no acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or other transformative corporate event.
